verdict.rationale: BVNK documents a broad API that mirrors several Portal functions. Wallets can be created and managed 'through the Portal or API', and direct customers access payment capabilities 'through the BVNK portal or API'. Rules, transfers, pay-in simulation, payouts and customer onboarding all have documented endpoints, and an llms.txt describes the complete API. However, there is no explicit claim that every UI action has an API equivalent, and API key generation is documented only through the Portal sidebar (Integrations > Generate API Key). Missing for 10: an explicit UI-API parity statement, API coverage of admin and account functions such as key management, and independent or hands-on confirmation of parity.
